We believe the language of "for any reason" as presently stated [BCO 9-2 impossible for any reason] gives us needed freedom to exercise our conscience regarding the teaching of scripture that included women within the office of deacon.

artifacts.synopsis: RE Reese and TE Bech complained that Philadelphia Presbytery erred in declaring their complaint out of order after Presbytery refused to allow any questions of TE Jason Hsu regarding his views on women deacons when approving his transfer to City Line Church. The SJC sustained the complaint, finding that deeming parts of a complaint objectionable is insufficient grounds to rule the whole complaint out of order, though it agreed the proposed amends (removing TE Hsu) were not appropriate.

artifacts.synopsis: Northern California Presbytery adopted an abstract resolution declaring six different views on the diaconate permissible for ministers and Sessions; the SJC sustained the complaints and annulled the resolution, holding that no court may issue binding abstract decrees beyond its proper jurisdictional exercise. A concurring opinion analyzed each of the six diaconal views in detail and set out standards (the GUMP/Kniseley framework) for when diaconal assistant practices are constitutionally permissible.

artifacts.title: Deacon and session authority to sell donated church property

matches.evidence: CCB advised that deacons, subject to session approval and congregational consent, hold authority to sell church property such as donated stock.

artifacts.title: Requiring session and diaconate membership reporting in RAO 16

matches.evidence: The CCB found an overture amending RAO 16 to mandate statistical reporting on session and diaconate membership and duties to be in conflict with existing BCO provisions.

artifacts.title: Appointing unordained men and women to diaconal ministry roles

matches.evidence: CCB found an overture appointing unordained persons to diaconal ministry in conflict with the Constitution, including because it implied an unordained office contrary to BCO 17-1.
